g.title: middle
g.text: Required on the normal task path
Interpret evidence / not every internal step

g.title: low
g.text: Dispatch the selected device path when needed

g.title: blocked
g.text: No blind retry of unknown effects

g.title: acceptance
g.text: One agent: role/LLM fit + bounded authority + compatible handoff
Five-area Reference + tables + at least 3 SVG/source pairs + evidence

g.title: legend
g.text: Solid: proposed flow Dashed: safety, context, evidence or escalation
High: agent-local LLM decisions. Middle: software/APIs. Low: devices.
Guardian and Knowledge are cross-cutting. Not five sequential stages or extra model calls.
